derivation: perhaps from the base of G2068 (ἐσθίω);

occurrences.text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
